g.text: Conditional PTN–CNNM2 association: b = -0.081 per mediator SD, p = 0.0176, BH FDR = 0.0598 | Dx attenuation = 12.7%
Values remove centered age, sex and SpD effects; middle panel also removes the centered mediator effect.
ΔDx = SCZ − NTC. P-values/FDR are from the original donor-blocked limma fits; boxes supply no new statistical tests.
Each point is a donor–SpD observation; multiple points from one donor are not independent. Shared outcome y-axis.
Selection: External human and experimental evidence connects CNNM2 to schizophrenia-related cortical and synaptic phenotypes. This is a literature-based nomination,
not a locus-specific finding from this mediation screen.
